edge_contract_review.typical90_bh: Strict increase then strict decrease, arbitrary subsequence; peak may be first/last. N<=300000,1<=Ai<=N. Per-index ending LIS, not whole-prefix optimum.
edge_contract_review.typical90_bi: Q<=1e5; card values<=1e9; valid indexed reads do not remove cards. At least one insertion and read.
edge_contract_review.typical90_bl: N,Q<=1e5; signed initial values and updates within +/-1e9. Inclusive accumulating ranges; N1 has zero differences; left boundary +V/right boundary -V.
edge_contract_review.typical90_bo: Input octal string has numeric value<8^20; K<=100; no leading zero. Convert to base9 then replace EVERY8->5, reinterpret next as base8; zero retained. Numeric value cannot increase.
edge_contract_review.typical90_bq: N<=1e18,K<=1e9; distances1 or2 must differ; colors may be unused. N1/N2 explicit, no solutions with N>=3,K<3.
edge_contract_review.typical90_br: Any plane location permitted, including non-input/non-integer; coordinate medians give integer optimum. Repeated/signed coordinates allowed,N<=1e5,coordinates +/-1e9; output cost only.
